SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year,'0101');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'1231');

#DROP TABLE IF EXISTS s_person_pyramid;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_person_pyramid(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) DEFAULT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) DEFAULT NULL,
	groupcode int(2) DEFAULT 0,
	groupname varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
	male int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	female int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	total int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year,groupcode),
	KEY (hospcode),
  KEY (areacode),
  KEY (groupcode)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_person_pyramid WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_person_pyramid 
(
id,hospcode,areacode,flag_sent,date_com,b_year,groupcode,groupname,male,female,total
)
(
SELECT
	@id,tt.hospcode,tt.areacode,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s')
	,(@b_year+543),tt.groupcode,tt.groupname,tt.male,tt.female,tt.total
FROM
(
			(
			SELECT
				hospcode,areacode
				,'1' as groupcode ,'0-4 ปี' as groupname
				,SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'ชาย' THEN result ELSE 0 END) as male 
				,SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'หญิง' THEN result ELSE 0 END) as female
				,SUM(CASE WHEN sex in('ชาย','หญิง') THEN result ELSE 0 END) as total
			FROM
				t_person_sex_age190
			WHERE groupcode in(1,2)
					AND SUBSTR(areacode,1,2) = @prov_c
			GROUP BY areacode
			)
	UNION
		(SELECT
				hospcode,areacode
				,groupcode,groupname
				,SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'ชาย' THEN result ELSE 0 END) as male 
				,SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'หญิง' THEN result ELSE 0 END) as female
				,SUM(CASE WHEN sex in('ชาย','หญิง') THEN result ELSE 0 END) as total
		FROM
			t_person_sex_age190
		WHERE
				groupcode NOT in(1,2)
				AND SUBSTR(areacode,1,2) = @prov_c
		GROUP BY areacode,groupcode
			)
) as tt
ORDER BY areacode,abs(concat('00',groupcode))
);

WHERE 1=1 {where}
